create_dingtalk_adapter: create a DingTalk platform adapter using Stream Mode with card SDK support for AI Cards
connect_dingtalk_stream: connect the DingTalk adapter to DingTalk via Stream Mode WebSocket for real-time message reception
send_markdown_reply: send a markdown-formatted reply to a DingTalk conversation via session webhook
create_ai_card_stream: create an AI Card and stream content updates with finalize control for streaming responses
edit_ai_card_message: edit an AI Card message by streaming updated content with optional finalize to close the card
